strongest_angle: Hollywood unions—including SAG‑AFTRA, the American Federation of Musicians, and both Writers Guilds—have filed an amicus brief asking a federal judge to reject a fair‑use exemption for training OpenAI’s models on unlicensed creative works, arguing that such training causes concrete harms to their members.

key_facts.fact: SAG‑AFTRA, the American Federation of Musicians, the Writers Guild of America East and the Writers Guild of America West jointly filed an amicus brief supporting plaintiffs in the OpenAI copyright case.
The four unions filed the memorandum of law on 29 October 2026 in the Southern District of New York.
The filing took place in the Southern District of New York, the federal court that is handling the consolidated copyright litigation against OpenAI.
